gloss: to be at one's wits' end; to be completely at a loss

definitions.gloss: to be at one's wits' end; to be completely at a loss
definitions.explanation: To be so troubled by a problem that one has no idea what to do. The second element, meaning 'to come to an end', adds 'utterly'.

examples.japanese: ⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧{困|こま}り{果|は}てた。
examples.english: I was completely at my wits' end.

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷|まよ}って→迷う：02426_mayou⟧{困|こま}り{果|は}てて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I had lost my way and was at a complete loss.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{騒音|そうおん}→騒音：03315_souon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{困|こま}り{果|は}てて、⟦{管理会社|かんりがいしゃ}→管理会社：23531_kanrigaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
examples.english: At my wits' end over the noise from next door, I consulted the management company.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive. The cause is marked with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: ⟦{騒音|そうおん}→騒音：03315_souon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{困|こま}り{果|は}てる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧{困|こま}り{果|は}てる: to be utterly at a loss
- {困|こま}り{果|は}てた⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧: a look of utter helplessness
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{困|こま}り{果|は}てる: to be at one's wits' end over ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{困|こま}る→困る：00861_komaru⟧: to be troubled; the plain verb
- ⟦{途方|とほう}に{暮|く}れる→途方に暮れる：17548_tohounikureru⟧: to be at a loss, not knowing which way to turn; close in meaning, more literary
